_about: Regression cases for tools/suite.ps1 (PLAN Phase 16). Each case is one isolated diag.ps1 run: its switches, how long it runs, what saves it starts from, and the checks tools/suite/analyze.py makes on its log, samples and screenshots. Patterns are regular expressions over the log, case-sensitive. 'quick' cases make up suite.ps1 -Quick. 'requires' lists paths under the project the case needs; without them it is skipped. Shots are numbered from 0 every shot_ms of presented frames; goldens are local (test/suite/goldens/<case>/), made with -UpdateGoldens.

cases.name: boot
cases.about: Title to main menu on a fresh console: legal screens, Start on the title, Choose a Look, Enter Name, Done (A) saves the new career, then the main menu (about 18 s in), drawn at full rate.

cases.name: ml1
cases.about: A new career into ML1 (Millicent 1, the first run) and riding to the end of the case: weaving with a jump every 1.5 s (pads/ml1.pad). Full rate, no pacing resync storm, flat memory.

cases.name: reload3
cases.about: Into ML1, then three times: ride 15 s, Pause, Leave Mountain (straight back to Career), and back onto the mountain through the menus (pads/reload3.pad). The level loads four times; memory stays flat across the reloads.

cases.name: movie
cases.about: The boot movies play to the end with nobody at the pad, then the legal screen and the title, drawn at full rate. The front-end boarder is loaded only once the intro has ended. Intro.xmv is 60.9 s (1801 frames at 29.6 fps; its header and its audio agree). The pre-sync build took 79 s from the intro to the front end; since the v0.16 sync it takes 150-180 s (2026-10-30). Shots of a movie depend on its timing, so they get no golden.

durations.known: the intro plays at about 0.4x since the v0.16 merge (RE-Amped2.cand.exe, 2026-10-28: 153 s; pre-sync 79 s)

cases.name: texpack
cases.about: The texture pack in mods\texture_pack is used in ML1: textures replaced, few misses.

numbers.pattern: texture pack: \d+ replaced, (\d+) not in the pack

cases.name: mods
cases.about: Loose entries in mods\loose are merged at start-up, and the front end comes up with them.

shots.what: main menu with the loose labels

cases.name: soak
cases.about: 60 minutes on ML1 (the soak7 numbers): no crash, about 59 fps, memory flat. Runs only when named or with -Soak.
